<h2 class="listing-title"><a href="/interesearch/">Some Studies of Language Model Weight Edits</a></h2>

I tested edits to a 67M-parameter language model across three language pairs. At comparable levels of damage to German, Spanish or French, an edit to one decomposition component spared the related language better than the other methods I tested. The learned updates preserved English predictions better.

In a second study, I tested repairs for fine-tunes that damage both German and Dutch. When both runs had little data and few training steps, starting from an earlier repair restored more of the lost Dutch performance than starting fresh. With the full fitting budget, a fresh repair nearly caught up.

<p class="entry-topics">interpretability · model editing</p>
